description: Supplications from the Qur'an, as collected on Life With Allah (lifewithallah.com, Main Adhkar → Quranic Duas), with that page's translation and transliteration. Not a wird: no built-in collection points here; these are for people building their own collections. Only the duʿāʾ that are part of an ayah are here - the words of the supplication without the narration around them (qāla rabbi..., wa-qul rabbi...), or a passage that begins or ends mid-ayah. A duʿāʾ that is whole ayahs is not copied, because the ayahs themselves are already addable: al-Fātiḥa, 3:8, 14:40-41, 26:83-85 with 26:87-89, and 37:100. Two more on the page are already in the library: the duʿāʾ of Yūnus (20032) and of the People of the Cave (8040). Each dhikr cites its ayahs through sources.json, and its notes carry the page's heading for it.

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّيْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, I have certainly wronged myself, so forgive me.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa-ghfirlī.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Musa ﷺ for Forgiveness

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be amongst the losers.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā ẓalamnā anfusanā wa il-lam taghfir lanā wa tarḥamnā la-nakūnanna minal-khāsirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Adam ﷺ and Hawwa for Forgiveness

adhkar.text_arabic: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۖ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us. You are the best of those who forgive.
adhkar.transliteration: Anta Walliyyunā fa-ghfir lanā war-ḥamnā wa Anta khayrul-ghāfirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Musa ﷺ for Forgiveness

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā in-nanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa qinā ʿadhāba-n-nār.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of the Pious for Forgiveness & Protection From the Hell-fire

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَآ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us: You are the Best of those who are merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā war-ḥamnā wa Anta khayru-r-rāḥimīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of the Slaves of Allah for Forgiveness & Mercy

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرّٰحِمِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy. You are the Best of those who are merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir wa-rḥam wa Anta khayru-r-rāḥimīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Forgiveness & Mercy

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِيْ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِيْ وَتَرْحَمْنِيْ أَكُنْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, I seek Your protection from asking You anything about which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I shall be amongst the losers.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi innī aʿūdhu bika an as’alaka mā laysa lī bihī ʿilm, wa il-lā taghfir lī wa tarḥamnī aku-m-mina-l-khāsirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Nuh ﷺ for Forgiveness

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُوْنَا بِالْإِيْمَانِ، وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِيْ قُلُوْبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith. Do not put in our hearts any hatred toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are the Most Compassionate, the Ever-Merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lanā wa li-ikhwānina-l-ladhīna sabaqūnā bil-īmān, wa lā tajʿal fī qulūbinā ghilla-l-lil-ladhīna āmanū Rabbanā innaka Ra’ūfu-r-Raḥīm.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Yourself, the Deceased & the Ummah

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُوْرَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are All-Powerful over everything.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā wa-ghfir lanā innaka ʿalā kulli shay’in Qadīr.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of the Believers on the Day of Judgement

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِيْ الْجَنَّةِ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, build for me, near You, a house in Paradise.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi-b-ni lī ʿindaka baytan fi-l-Jannah.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Asiya for a House Near Allah in Paradise

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا، إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَّمُقَامًا
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, turn away from us the punishment of Hell-fire. Indeed, its punishment is endless. Indeed it is an evil residence and abode.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbana-ṣrif ʿan-nā ʿadhāba Jahannam, inna ʿadhābahā kāna gharāmā. Innahā sā’at mustaqarra-w-wa muqāmā.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Protection From the Hell-fire

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بٰطِلًا، سُبْحٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ، رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُۥ ۖ وَمَا لِلظّٰلِمِيْنَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ، رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُّنَادِىْ لِلْإِيْمَٰنِ أَنْ اٰمِنُوْا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاٰمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّاٰتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ، رَبَّنَا وَاٰتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, You have not created all this (the heavens and the earth) without purpose- You are free from any defects- so protect us from the torment of the Fire. Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire, You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], ‹Believe in your Lord,› so we have believed. Our Lord, forgive us our sins, wipe out our bad deeds, and let us die with the truly righteous. Our Lord, bestow upon us all that You have promised us through Your messengers and do not humiliate us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You never break Your promise.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā mā khalaqta hādhā bāṭilā, subḥānaka faqinā ʿadhāba-n-nār. Rabbanā innaka man tudkhili-n-nāra fa-qad akhzaytah, wa mā li-ẓ-ẓālimīna min anṣār. Rabbanā in-nanā samiʿnā munādiya-y-yunādī lil-īmāni an āminū bi-Rabbikum fa-āmannā, Rabbanā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa kaffir ʿannā sayyi’ātinā wa tawaffanā ma-ʿal-abrār. Rabbanā wa ātinā mā wa-ʿadtanā ʿalā rusulika wa lā tukhzinā yawmal-qiyāmah, in-naka lā tukhliful-mīʿād.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Those Who Reflect

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَّعِلْمًا، فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِيْنَ تَابُوْا وَاتَّبَعُوْا سَبِيْلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيْمِ، رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِيْ وَعَدْتَّهُمْ وَمَنْ صَلَحَ مِنْ اٰبَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ، وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَمَنْ تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ، وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيْمُ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your path, and protect them from the punishment of Hell-fire. Our Lord, admit them to the eternal gardens of Paradise which You have promised them, along with whoever was righteous from their fathers, their spouses and their children. Indeed, You, and only You, are the All-Mighty and All-Wise. Protect them from all evil deeds. You will have bestowed Your mercy on those You protect from the evil deeds on that Day: that is the greatest achievement indeed.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā wasiʿta kulla shay’i-r-raḥmata-w-wa ʿilmā, fa-ghfir lil-ladhīna tābū wa-t-tabaʿū sabīlaka wa qihim ʿadhābal-jaḥīm. Rabbanā wa adkhil-hum jannāti ʿadnini-l-latī wa-ʿadtahum wa man ṣalaḥa min ābā’ihim wa azwājihim wa dhurriy-yātihim, innaka Antal-ʿAzīzu-l-Ḥakīm. Wa qihimu-s-sayyi’āt, wa man taqi-s-sayyi’āti yawma’idhin fa-qad raḥimtah, wa dhālika huwal-fawzul-ʿAẓīm.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of the Angels for the Believers

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّيْ لِمَآ أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيْرٌ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, truly I am in dire need of any good which You may send me.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi innī limā anzalta illayya min khayrin faqīr.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Musa ﷺ Expressing His Dire Need

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَآ اٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fi-d-dunyā ḥasanah wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāba-n-Nār.
adhkar.benefits:
Anas (raḍiy Allāhu ‘anhu) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would supplicate with [the above]. (Bukhārī 4522)
In another narration, Qatāda (raḥimahullāh) asked Anas (raḍiy Allāhu ‘anhu) which supplication the Messenger of Allah ﷺ frequently made. He said: “The supplication that the Prophet ﷺ made very frequently is [the above]. He (Qatāda) said that whenever Anas had to supplicate he made this very supplication, and whenever he (intended) to make another supplication he (added) this supplication in it too.” (Muslim 2690)
Some of the companions of Anas (raḍiy Allāhu ‘anhu) requested him to supplicate for them. So he supplicated with the [the above] blessed supplication. He then said: “If Allah grants you that (good in this world and good in the Hereafter), then He has granted you ‘all’ goodness.” (Fatḥ al-Bārī)
adhkar.notes: The Most Frequent Duʿa of the Prophet ﷺ

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِيْ عِلْمًا
adhkar.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi zidnī ʿilmā.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Increase in Knowledge

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِيْ صَدْرِيْ، وَيَسِّرْ لِيْٓ أَمْرِيْ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, put my heart at peace for me, and make my task easy for me.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi-sh-shraḥ lī ṣadrī. Wa yassir lī amrī.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Musa ﷺ for Inner Peace & Strength

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِيْ صَغِيْرًا
adhkar.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them (my parents) as they raised and nurtured me when I was young.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi-r-ḥamhumā kamā rabbayānī ṣaghīrā.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Parents

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِيْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً، إِنَّكَ سَمِيْعُ الدُّعَآءِ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself pious offspring. Indeed, You hear all prayers.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi hab lī mi-l-ladunka dhuriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka samīʿ-ud-duʿā’.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Zakariyya ﷺ for Pious Children

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِيْ فَرْدًا وَّأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْوٰرِثِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of inheritors.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi lā tadharnī farda-w-wa Anta khayrul-wārithīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Zakariyya ﷺ for Children

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَّاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ إِمَامًا
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, grant us spouses and offspring who will be a joy to our eyes, and make us leaders of those who have taqwa (piety).
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā hab lanā min azwājinā wa dhuriyyātinā qurrata aʿyuni-w-wajʿalnā lil-muttaqīna imāmā.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for a Joyous Household

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيْٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِيْٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ، وَأَدْخِلْنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِيْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good deeds that please You. And admit me by Your mercy amongst Your righteous servants.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi awziʿnī an ashkura niʿmataka-l-latī anʿamta ʿalayya wa ʿalā wālidayya wa an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāh, wa adkhilnī bi-raḥmatika fī ʿibādika-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Sulayman ﷺ for Gratitude to Allah & Doing Good Deeds

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيْٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِيْٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِيْ فِيْ ذُرِّيَّتِيْ، إِنِّيْ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّيْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good deeds that please You. Make my offspring righteous; I truly repent to you, and truly I am of those who submit to You.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi awziʿnī an ashkura niʿmataka-l-latī anʿamta ʿalayya wa ʿalā wālidayya wa an aʿmala ṣāliḥan tarḍāh, wa aṣliḥ lī fī dhuriyyatī, innī tubtu ilayka wa innī mina-l-muslimīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Gratitude, Good Deeds & Pious Children

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, I seek protection with You from the promptings of the devils; and I seek protection in You, my Lord, from their coming near me.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti-sh-shayāṭīn. Wa aʿūdhu bika Rabbi ay-yaḥḍurūn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Seeking Protection from Shaytan

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِنْ نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا، رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا، أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and do not lay upon us a burden as You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and do not burden us with that which we have no ability to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy upon us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tu’ākidhnā in-nasīnā aw akhṭa’nā, Rabbanā wa lā taḥmil ʿalaynā iṣran kamā ḥamaltahū ʿala-l-ladhīna min qablinā, Rabbanā wa lā tuḥammilnā mā lā ṭāqata lanā bih, waʿfu ʿanna wa-ghfir lanā war-ḥamnā Anta Mawlānā fa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmil-kāfirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Forgiveness & Ease

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِيٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our extravagance in our affairs. Make our feet firm, and help us against the disbelieving people.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā wa thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmil-kāfirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Forgiveness & Victory

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَّثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, pour upon us patience, make our steps firm and grant us victory over the disbelieving people.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabra-w-wa thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmil-kāfirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for For Firmness & Victory

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبِّ انْصُرْنِيْ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: My Lord, support me against the people who spread corruption.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbin-ṣurnī ʿala-l-qawmi-l-mufsidīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Lut ﷺ for Help Against The Corrupt

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, do not let us join the wrongdoing people.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tajʿalnā maʿal qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Protection From Being With The Oppressors

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِيْنَ، وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, do not make us victims of the oppressors. Save us, through Your mercy, from the disbelieving people.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnata-l-lil-qawmi-ẓ-ẓālimīn. Wa najjinā bi-raḥmatika mina-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Protection From The Oppressors

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ، رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُواْ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, in You Alone we trust, and to You Alone we turn, and to You is the ultimate return. Our Lord, do not let us be persecuted by those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed You, and only You, are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā ʿalayka tawakkalnā wa ilayka anabnā wa ilaykal-maṣīr. Rabbanā lā tajʿalnā fitnatal-lil-ladhīna kafarū wa-ghfir lanā Rabbanā, innaka Antal-ʿAzīzu-l-Ḥakīm.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa for Protection From Persecution

adhkar.text_arabic: (رَبِّ) أَنِّيْ مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنْتَ أَرْحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيْن
adhkar.translation: (My Lord), indeed adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: (Rabbi) Annī massaniya-ḍ-ḍurru wa Anta Arḥamu-r-rāḥimīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Ayyub ﷺ for Times of Distress. The bracketed (رَبِّ) opens it as a direct duʿāʾ; it is not part of the ayah.

adhkar.text_arabic: (اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا) فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، أَنْتَ وَلِيِّيْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، تَوَفَّنِيْ مُسْلِمًا وَّأَلْحِقْنِيْ بِالصَّالِحِيْنَ
adhkar.translation: (O Allah), Originator of the heavens and the earth, You are my Protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Make me die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
adhkar.transliteration: (Allāhumma yā) Fāṭira-s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍi Anta waliy-yi fi-d-dunyā wal-ākhirah, tawaffanī Muslimaw-wa alḥiqnī bi-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Yusuf ﷺ for A Good Ending. The bracketed (اَللّٰهُمَّ يَا) opens it as a direct duʿāʾ; it is not part of the ayah.

adhkar.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيْعُ الْعَلِيْمُ، وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيْمُ
adhkar.translation: Our Lord, accept from us. Indeed, You – and You alone – are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. And accept our repentance. Indeed, You -and You alone – are the Acceptor of repentance, the very Merciful.
adhkar.transliteration: Rabbanā taqabbal minnā innaka Anta-s-Samīʿu-l-ʿAlīm. Wa tub ʿalaynā innaka Anta-t-Tawwābu-r-Raḥīm.
adhkar.notes: Duʿa of Prophet Ibrahim ﷺ & Ismaʿil ﷺ for Acceptance of Good Deeds
